Class Definition 3.2.1 Natural grassland
Grasslands under no or moderate human influence, with low productivity. […]; frequently including rocky areas or patches of other (semi-)natural vegetation. Natural grasslands are areas with herbaceous vegetation […]. Besides, areas of shrub formations, of scattered trees and of mineral outcrops also occur. Often under nature conservation. In this context "natural" indicates a minimum human interference, (not drained, irrigated, sown, fertilized). […] Maintenance mowing and shrub clearance for prevention of woody overgrowth due to natural succession is tolerated. […]
